description:
The shared delete/archive lifecycle module in the API and the CRM CRUD kit that every other workstream consumes. Runs alone; nothing else starts until this merges.

Epic: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/epics.md (Epic 1)
Architecture: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture.md
Requires: nothing — this is first
Blocks: W2, W3, W4, W5, W6, W7

userStories.title: Lifecycle registry and deleteOrExplain
userStories.description: As the back office, I want a single mechanism that decides whether a row can be deleted, so that a delete can never silently destroy commercial history.
acceptanceCriteria: A frozen registry declares table, id column, archivability and dependency probes per entity
The parent row is locked SELECT ... FOR UPDATE (never FOR NO KEY UPDATE) before probes run
Probes run as one round trip, each LIMIT 101, reporting { count: 100, capped: true } past that
Probes count archived rows too
A blocked delete returns status 409 with blockers and archivable; it is a return value, never a thrown error
A pg 23503 is caught and mapped to the same 409 shape as a backstop
Success is 200 { deleted: { entity, id } }
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: setArchived replaces the eight duplicated archive helpers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one archive implementation, so that the now()/NULL fragment and its 404 stop being copied per module.
acceptanceCriteria: All eight callers delegate to setArchived and keep their own return shape
The order state machine keeps withOrderTxn and its terminal-state guard
Existing archive tests pass untouched — that is the proof this was a move, not a rewrite
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Registry safety tests
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want the registry itself proven safe, so that a malformed probe cannot reach production.
acceptanceCriteria: Every probe matches /^SELECT 1 FROM [a-z_ ]/ and contains exactly one $1
Every relation name matches /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$/
Every declared table and id column exists in information_schema.columns
A test asserts no route registers an entity name from a path parameter
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: CRM list kit: list.js, useAdminList, Pagination
userStories.description: As a CRM developer, I want one list hook and one paginator, so that eight new screens do not copy-paste a ninth.
acceptanceCriteria: buildListQuery drops null, undefined and empty string so an "All" select never sends role=
useAdminList depends on the serialised query string, not the filters object
Changing a filter resets page to 1
Emptying the last page steps back one page
The active flag guards StrictMode double-mount
Pagination returns null when totalPages <= 1
Pure logic is unit-tested in .js siblings; the .jsx holds no rules
Gates green: `( cd atelier-crm && npm test && npm run build )`

userStories.title: CRM delete kit: ConfirmDialog, deleteFlow, useCrudScreen, apiDelete
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want a blocked delete explained in place, so that I can archive instead without losing my place.
acceptanceCriteria: apiDelete sends no body and no JSON content-type, so Fastify cannot answer FST_ERR_CTP_EMPTY_JSON_BODY
There is no pre-flight can-I-delete request
On 409 the dialog stays open and renders the blocker lines plus an Archive instead action
describeBlockers falls back to messageOf when the body is missing
ConfirmDialog sets role="dialog" aria-modal="true"; Escape cancels; focus lands on Cancel
Gates green: `( cd atelier-crm && npm test && npm run build )`

userStories.title: CI workflows for all three repos
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want gates verified independently of the agent that wrote the code, so that a self-reported green is not the only evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Each workflow triggers on pull requests targeting august-6th-updates
The api workflow runs a postgres:14 service container and sets DATABASE_URL
The crm workflow runs npm test and npm run build (there is no ESLint in that repo)
No workflow references a typecheck step
No workflow can push or write to main/master
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`
Gates green: `( cd atelier-crm && npm test && npm run build )`
Gates green: `( cd atelier-storefront && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build )`
